_readme: Copy to ~/.claude/agent-teams.json and change only the roles you want elsewhere. Every role listed below defaults to 'claude' — deleting this file restores stock behavior. Engines: claude | codex | kimi | grok | cursor. See skills/team-feature/references/engines.md.
_second_reviewer_note: Optional and off by default — second-reviewer is the one exception: it is off unless you list it. To switch it on, add "second-reviewer": "codex" (or kimi | cursor | claude) to the roles block above; its engine must differ from unified-reviewer's, otherwise the run warns once and skips it. It gives unified-reviewer a second opinion on tasks that reviewer marks SENSITIVE, and it never issues a verdict — the coder still hears one verdict, from unified-reviewer. If its engine is absent or dies, the run simply proceeds with the one reviewer.
_engines_note: Optional. Only needed when a CLI changes its flags or you want a different model/effort. Omit entirely to use the built-in presets.
_locked_roles: lead and browser-verifier are always Claude — lead owns the team and user dialogue, browser-verifier needs the Chrome extension. Assigning them elsewhere is ignored.
